reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Foliated metamorphic rock, likely paragneiss / mica schist / gneiss. Colour is medium to dark grey-blue with irregular pale white to light grey patches. Grain size appears medium-grained to fine-medium, inequigranular. Texture is strongly foliated / gneissic with a wavy to locally crenulated fabric; the foliation is defined by alternating darker grey and lighter quartz-feldspar rich layers. Locally the rock shows a mottled / nebulitic appearance with diffuse white quartz / feldspar patches.
description.alteration: none visible. No obvious chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic, carbonate or oxidised alteration can be confidently distinguished in the photo resolution.
description.mineralization: none visible. No visible sulfides or ore minerals such as pyrite, chalcopyrite, pyrrhotite, sphalerite or galena can be identified in the image.

anomalies.explanation: Top tray row shows a broken core piece on the left with a fresh fracture and a tapered / truncated core end on the right, indicating broken or missing core at the run start.
Third tray row shows a distinct angular fracture / break in the core on the left side of the row with offset pieces.
